name: Hanger 2
summary:
Hanger 2 is the sequel of the fun addicting rope swinging game and you can enjoy it online and for free on Silvergames.com. Once again, the poor little character has to swing all his way to the end of every level without hitting the walls or the floor, or being teared apart by spinning saws and other deadly traps.

Just click on the screen to make the rope extend to the ceiling, release it to push yourself forward and repeat it as many times as needed until you clear the level. Once you have passed the finish line, hope that the little guy lands as far as possible to earn more and more coins. Unlock new looks, like Spiderman, Super Mario and many others. Have fun with Hanger 2!
